label: AI Model
comment: Stress prediction model. Exists at different quality levels per continuum layer.

label: Accelerometer Sensor
comment: Determines user mobility and physical activity.

label: Adaptation Action
comment: Auditable action produced by an EvaluationState.

label: Artifact
comment: Versionable project artifact.

label: Authorization Decision
comment: Effective authorization obtained from the intersection of consent record, contract, zone and hard restrictions.

label: Buffer Record
comment: Temporary retained data record governed by authorization and storage policies.

label: Cloud Node
comment: Cloud continuum node for global processing. Selection is conditional on authorization and policies; it is not intrinsically preferred.

label: Community
comment: Group of users with similar mobility patterns and routines (neighbourhood, floor, hospital ward).

label: Computational Node
comment: Continuum architecture node capable of hosting models and processing data.

label: Consent Range
comment: Maximum processing scope declared by consent/contract. Includes LocalOnly, CommunityAgg, GlobalAgg and Denied/Revoked. Effective authorization is computed independently.

label: Consent Record
comment: User-declared consent decision independent from the semantic contract.

label: Data Category
comment: Semantic category of information governed by consent, privacy and transmission policies.

label: Data Context
comment: Operational context associated with data or a processing/transfer event.

label: Delegation Event
comment: Reified temporal delegation that records delegator node, delegate node, cause, validity interval and recovery condition.

label: EDA Sensor
comment: Electrodermal activity sensor.

label: Edge Node
comment: Edge continuum node. It is external to the local scope defined for raw physiological observations. Elasticity is a node capability, not a class invariant.

label: Evaluation State
comment: Derived by reasoning over NodeState + UserState + NodeUserRelation.

label: Federated Learning Session
comment: Event of parameter/model transfer between continuum layers (HFL).

label: Fog Node
comment: Fog continuum node for community/zone processing. Elasticity depends on deployment capability and is not fixed by the class.

label: Identifier
comment: Identifier that may be direct, pseudonymous or anonymous.

label: MAPE-K Symptom
comment: Symptom detected in the MAPE-K Monitor/Analyse phases and recorded for auditability.

label: Mist Node
comment: Closest node to the user. Minimal capacity, very low latency.

label: Mobile Device
comment: User smartphone acting as a personal Mist node. It belongs to the local processing scope when associated with the user.

label: Model Gradient Update
comment: Federated learning update that may leave a mobile device only after anonymization and noise addition.

label: Node-User Relation
comment: Captures distance and connectivity between a node and a user at a given instant.

label: Non-User
comment: Person in the environment without a wearable or active participation.

label: Parametrized Data
comment: Pre-computed and aggregated data. Raw physiological data never leaves the device.

label: Physiological Parametrized Data
comment: EDA, HR, SpO2, etc. Sent during the day or at night when conditions allow.

label: Policy
comment: Normative governance rule from POLICIES-REV-01. Policies are specifications, not execution mechanisms.

label: Processing Purpose
comment: Purpose for which data, model parameters or predictions are processed.

label: Replication Event
comment: Controlled and idempotent replication or synchronization event.

label: Restricted Zone
comment: Geographic zone with hard restrictions on external processing/transfer. Raw physiological observations remain on wearable/mobile or authorised personal Mist; Edge, Fog and Cloud are external to local scope.

label: Rural Zone
comment: Few nodes. Predominance of local retention and controlled transmission.

label: Semantic Contract
comment: Temporal agreement binding user, processing purpose(s), consent range and governing policies. It is independent from the user-declared ConsentRecord.

label: Service
comment: Stress prediction or any other continuum service.

label: Sleep Parametrized Data
comment: Sleep quality and phase durations. Generated when the user wakes up.

label: Sleep Sensor
comment: Captures total duration, phases (REM, deep, light) and sleep quality.

label: SpO2 Sensor
comment: Blood oxygen saturation sensor.

label: State
comment: Dynamic state of an entity; temporal and distinguishable from instantaneous observations.

label: Stress Observation
comment: Output of the stress prediction model.

label: Skin Temperature Sensor
comment: Skin temperature — used as stress indicator.

label: Temporal Entity
comment: Entity with an explicit validity interval. validTo denotes effective closure, never merely planned expiry.

label: Traffic Window
comment: Time interval with high demand (morning: wake-up; night: physiological data upload).

label: Transfer Event
comment: Auditable transfer of data, model updates or other payloads.

label: Trust Assessment
comment: Versioned assessment explaining a trust score.

label: Urban Environment
comment: Geographic and density context that conditions system connectivity and behaviour.

label: Urban Zone
comment: High node and user density. More communication options.

label: User
comment: System participant with a wearable device.

label: Wearable
comment: Personal IoT device (smartwatch, smart ring, smart band).

label: Zone type
comment: A zone classification referenced by policies. UrbanZone, RuralZone and RestrictedZone are both OWL classes and named ZoneType individuals; OWL 2 DL treats their class and individual interpretations separately.

label: applies policy
comment: Deprecated in v3.0.0; use ex:appliedPolicy. Use appliedPolicy

label: continuum level
comment: Physical/logical continuum level only; not a preference or quality ranking.

label: delegates requests to
comment: Used when a node is saturated or disconnected. For temporal delegation, use an ex:DelegationEvent with ex:validFrom/ex:validTo and ex:delegatedBy.

label: derived from
comment: SOSA observation that originated this state and provides its timestamp.

label: expires on recovery of
comment: Use semantic RecoveryCondition together with validTo/plannedExpiry.

label: governed by
comment: Links users, nodes, services, zones or sessions to the applicable policy according to location and processing context.

label: has AHP / multicriteria score
comment: Score of a specific candidate alternative. For AHP it is the AHP result; for other methods the DecisionMethod identifies the scoring semantics.

label: has active consent range
comment: Current user-declared range resolved from the active ConsentRecord. It is intentionally independent from the SemanticContract so inconsistencies can be detected.

label: has neighbor node
comment: Adjacent node to which requests can be delegated.

label: has policy action
comment: Policy action is now described by the normative policy statement and linked mechanisms/actions; retained only for compatibility.

label: has privacy budget
comment: Differential privacy epsilon value for the FL session.

label: has trust score
comment: Normalized historical reliability score [0,1]. A v3-compliant scientific use should also reference TrustAssessment with rule version and historical window.

label: has external trust weight
comment: External trust criterion used to filter/order already eligible alternatives. It is not part of AHP weight normalization.

label: is preferred node
comment: Historical preferred node for this user based on zone and load.

label: is redundant
comment: Redundant or repetitive data — candidate for elimination to reduce traffic.

label: legacy decision score
comment: Legacy single winning score retained for provenance. It is not equivalent to v3 per-alternative scores.

label: noise level
comment: Magnitude of noise injected into gradients or model parameters before transfer.

label: planned expiry
comment: Planned deadline distinct from effective closure validTo.

label: requires consent range
comment: Minimum consent-aware processing scope required for an action, policy, model tier or FL session.

label: selected model tier
comment: Model tier selected by the AHP-style decision balance.

label: state duration
comment: Computed as validTo - validFrom.

label: user feedback score
comment: User rating of the previous day's prediction (local model without consent).

label: uses model
comment: Model used by a service. Distinct from hostsModel, whose subject is a ComputationalNode.

label: valid from
comment: Effective start timestamp of a temporal entity.

label: valid to
comment: Effective closure timestamp. It must not be used for a planned expiration before actual closure.
